title: ZAFF3 spectroscopic field with periodic dynamics continuation
summary: Extend a certified ZAFF3 field by sparse periodic LAM-SAM response terms that remain exactly dormant over its spectroscopic stencil and retain the ZAFF dissociation switches.
gates: ORACLE supplies the immutable flexible-torsion representatives and SMITH supplies the frozen primitive identities
periodic continuation is C2 and exactly zero over every geometry in the parent spectroscopic stencil
every added term retains all defining-bond dissociation switches and is independently asymptotically correct
fit targets only the residual energy and analytic gradient after the complete preceding ZAFF level
independent off-grid LAM holdout maximum energy error is at most 0.5 cm-1
independent off-grid LAM holdout maximum Cartesian-gradient error is at most 5e-4 Eh/angstrom
analytic added Hessian is exactly zero on the complete parent spectroscopic stencil
LINK minimum optimization converges and MIFUNE NVE energy drift passes the stored dynamics gate
coordinate_policy: Fit local inverse-distance, cosine and Fourier products in the frozen redundant ZAFF primitives. Activate finite-amplitude LAM-SAM response with a versioned periodic C2 outer window beyond the largest parent spectroscopic displacement.
backend_policy: Acquire independent B3LYP-D3BJ energy and analytic-gradient holdouts through LINK on ORACLE; ARCHITECT owns the residual fit, LINK owns optimization and MIFUNE owns dynamics.
